body.purpose: Running copy, all UI chrome, and every price.

lead.purpose: Intro/lede copy under a section heading, in Tinta, capped at 62ch.

shadows.name: button-hover-lift

shadows.name: mobile-nav-panel

motion.name: ease-standard

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — solid Oliva Profundo, Crema text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .6rem; min-height: 58px; padding: 1rem 2rem; background: #3A4433; color: #F7F4EC; border: 1px solid #3A4433; font: 600 1.02rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.005em; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), box-shadow .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2C3427; border-color: #2C3427; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -10px rgba(28,25,23,.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3A4433; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent with hairline border, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .6rem; min-height: 58px; padding: 1rem 2rem; background: transparent; color: #3A4433; border: 1px solid rgba(58,68,51,.18); font: 600 1.02rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), color .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #3A4433; color: #F7F4EC; border-color: #3A4433; box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -10px rgba(28,25,23,.3); }

components.name: Product Card

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-decoration: none; color: #1C1917; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-card-ph { aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: linear-gradient(152deg,#8A9370 0%,#6B7B3C 48%,#3A4433 100%); transition: filter .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-ph { filter: brightness(1.08) saturate(1.12); } .ds-card-b { padding: .9rem 0 0; } .ds-card-l { font: 500 .63rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #54584B; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; margin-bottom: .45rem; } .ds-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6B7B3C; flex: none; display: inline-block; } .ds-card-t { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.14; margin: 0 0 .25rem; } .ds-card-f { font-size: .82rem; color: #54584B; margin: 0 0 .55rem; } .ds-card-p { font: 500 .95rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; margin: 0; }

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Rotating-chevron expand/collapse; the one pattern used for every <details> on the site.
components.html:
¿Para qué piel?
Texto del cuerpo del acordeón, hasta 62ch de medida.
components.css: .ds-acc { border-top: 1px solid rgba(58,68,51,.18); } .ds-acc details { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(58,68,51,.18); } .ds-acc summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 1.1rem 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font: 500 1rem/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color: #3A4433; } .ds-acc summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-acc summary::after { content: ""; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-right: 1.5px solid #3A4433; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #3A4433; transform: rotate(45deg) translateY(-3px); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); flex: none; } .ds-acc details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(225deg) translateY(-3px); } .ds-acc-body { padding: 0 0 1.3rem; font-size: .95rem; color: #54584B; max-width: 62ch; }

components.name: Nav Link (desktop header)
components.description: Header nav item with animated gold underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: .7rem .85rem; text-decoration: none; color: #3A4433; font: 500 .78rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); display: inline-block; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(58,68,51,.07); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: .85rem; right: .85rem; bottom: .32rem; height: 1.5px; background: #B08D3F; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: Muted earth over warm cream, organic material, subtle grain — laid across an asymmetric magazine grid with editorial type and generous air. The stated anti-references are explicit and load-bearing: not a spa, not a pharmacy, not a kraft-and-leaf "eco" brand. The working metaphor is a publication about the olive tree that happens to also sell what it produces. The system runs almost shadow-free: separation comes from a 1px hairline and surface-color changes, not elevation. Motion is deliberately slow and restrained — hover changes color, border, or opacity, never scale or layout position. Corners are sharp-to-slightly-eased — nothing reads as an app or a SaaS product; the brand is material, not soft.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, desaturated earth palette on a cream ground, never bright or saturated
Editorial serif for display copy, a workhorse sans for everything functional
Hairline borders and color-surface shifts instead of shadows/elevation
Sharp, contained corners — explicitly no fully-rounded ("pill") buttons, tags, or badges
Slow, subtle, transform/opacity-only motion; respects prefers-reduced-motion everywhere

rules.name: The Gold-Never-Text Rule
rules.body: Oro Arauco is a border, hairline, hover accent, and focus-ring color only — never typographic text (2.84:1 on Crema, fails AA).

rules.name: The Oliva CTA Rule
rules.body: The call-to-action is always Oliva Profundo background with Crema text (9.30:1, AAA); never substituted with gold.

rules.name: The No-Serif-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Prices are always Inter, never the display serif — ambiguous numerals in a high-contrast serif are a checkout risk.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every static block sits at zero elevation. Shadow only appears as a hover/open-state response, never as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The No-Pills Rule
rules.body: No border-radius of 100px or more anywhere — buttons, toggles, badges, tags, and chips are all excluded from full rounding.

dos: Do use Oliva Profundo + Crema for every primary CTA — no substitution for aesthetic reasons.
Do keep Oro Arauco to borders, hairlines, hover accents, and focus rings only.
Do set body copy and all prices in Inter; reserve the display serif for headlines and large-size moments.
Do keep motion to transform/opacity only, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do treat the .ph gradient-and-grain placeholder as a legitimate stand-in for missing product photography, not a broken state.
donts: Don't set #6B7B3C (Hoja) as body text — it fails AA at 4.22:1; use #616F36 instead.
Don't introduce a border-radius of 100px or more on any button, tag, chip, or badge.
Don't add a third typeface for any reason.
Don't add resting-state box-shadows to cards, headers, or footers.
Don't invent a second expand/collapse visual pattern — reuse the rotating-chevron .acc treatment everywhere.
